literal_meaning: অস্পষ্টভাবে বারবার উচ্চারণ করা (indistinctly repeating sounds)
figurative_meaning_en: To mutter or talk to oneself in indistinct or unclear pronunciation
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে রাগ করে বিড়বিড় করতে লাগল।
ঘুমের মধ্যে ছেলেটি বিড়বিড় করে কথা বলছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He started muttering to himself in anger.
The boy is talking indistinctly in his sleep.
note: Commonly used to describe quiet, unclear self-muttering, often in frustration or during sleep
